title: City of Toronto 2025 Corporate Asset Management Plan
notes: Linked as '2025 Corporate Asset Management Plan'. PDF opened: 395 pages. Council item 2025.EX23.7.

extraction.reason: Read by hand on 2026-10-21 (all 395 pages searched for life values). No component lives. Each service area has an inventory table with Average Age and Average ESL by asset class, weighted by replacement value; for buildings these are whole-building figures, e.g. Corporate Real Estate facilities ESL 50 (p165), Library Branches 50 (p117), Subsidized Housing 32 (p204), Heritage Buildings 265 (p108).

title: The Regional Municipality of York 2024 Corporate Asset Management Plan
notes: PDF opened (143 pages, May 2024); the link redirects to https://www.york.ca/media/119076/download. The same page links 2025 and 2026 Corporate Asset Management Progress Reports, which are progress reports, not new plans.

extraction.reason: Read by hand on 2026-10-21 (all 143 pages searched for life values). No building component lives. The only facility lives are transit total-life replacement figures on p67: garage structures 50, terminals 50, garage equipment 5 to 25, transit stop platforms 10 to 15, transit stop shelters 15 years.
